# Historical native documents

Unmodified `.solidcraft` fixtures from [SolidCraft](https://github.com/bherbruck/solidcraft),
`apps/solidcraft-cli/tests/corpus`, revision `926a7353a377e342d2718971fb259fae517d1ddd`.
MIT OR Apache-2.0; original license texts are included. Do not regenerate these historical files.

They exercise older schema versions, component occurrences, a parametric hinge joint, sheet
metal, plastic rules/features, path patterns, face naming, split bodies, appearances and desktop
sketch history. All fixtures undergo exact document preservation and source fixed-point tests.
Engine tests separately check paired loading/migration, inspection and measured geometry.

New native fields need no field-specific translation: the source preserves arbitrary document
values. Add real saved files here when extending engine behavior to broaden behavioral coverage.
